summary: Frontend-only smoke of iteration 11 (Partner sub-pages / SPA routing). All 12 requested checks pass: home renders full landing with PartnersV2, all 23 flat vendors are React Router <Link> anchors with data-testid="vendor-{slug}", rack-hover grid renders <Link> anchors with data-testid="vendor-{cat}-{i}", /partners/:slug pages render the full spec (chips, tier, name, tagline, logo, intro, 3 highlights, N products, CTA, back link), Proxmox text-fallback, Pure Storage hyphen slug, 404 fallback and i18n toggle all work, back link navigates to /#partners-rack (SPA), 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnerDetailPage.jsx uses window.scrollTo({behavior: 'instant'}) — 'instant' is not part of the ScrollBehavior enum in the spec (only 'auto' or 'smooth'). Chrome/Firefox tolerate it and fall back to auto, but Safari may warn. Consider {behavior: 'auto'}.
In /app/frontend/src/data/partners.js the PARTNERS_BY_SLUG uses reduce+spread which is O(n^2). Not a problem at 23 entries but a plain Object.fromEntries(PARTNERS.map(p => [p.slug, p])) is cleaner.

PartnersV2Section still keeps a local VENDOR_LOGOS map that duplicates data already in partners.js — a future refactor could source logo/name from PARTNERS to avoid drift (e.g. Huawei/Pure Storage/uptime DC/xorux/proxmox all currently rely on text fallback in the rack because they are missing from VENDOR_LOGOS).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 added /partners/:slug SPA route. Verified via Playwright at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Key observations for next iterations: (1) rack-slot hover in PartnersV2 must be simulated with page.focus() or dispatched mouseenter — page.hover triggers CSS :hover but the React state uses onMouseEnter which page.hover DOES fire; note that page.click on a vendor-* Link scrolls page but element may still be out of viewport if navbar is fixed — use JS scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) first. (2) Language toggle testid is [data-testid="lang-toggle"], its innerText stays 'PL/EN' but the LanguageContext swaps values. (3) All 23 slugs are exported from PARTNERS_BY_SLUG; slugs verified: netapp, dell, lenovo, asus, nutanix, microsoft, vmware, proxmox, huawei, pure-storage, commvault, veeam, arista, hpe, extreme-networks, cisco, brocade, sailpoint, baramundi, google, aws, uptime-dc, xorux.
